svg.title: 03 Lattices
svg.desc: Chapter 3. So I work on cryptography built from lattices. ML-KEM and ML-DSA, standardised by NIST in 2024, rest on lattice problems with no known efficient quantum attack. A long public basis morphs into a short secret one of the same area.

rest on lattice problems with no known efficient quantum
